+You are an expert in regular expressions and in repairing ReDoS (catastrophic backtracking) vulnerabilities.
+
+The regular expression below is vulnerable to ReDoS. First find the part that can backtrack catastrophically: nested quantifiers such as `(x+)+`, a repeated alternation whose branches overlap such as `(a|\w)+`, a repeated sequence with an optional separator such as `(\w+\s?)+`, adjacent quantified parts that match the same characters such as `\d+\d*`, or a leading repeated part in a regex that does not start with `^`.
+
+Rewrite the regular expression so that it can no longer backtrack catastrophically, while it still matches exactly the same set of strings as the original. Your answer is tested with Python re.fullmatch on random strings generated from both the original and your regex, and with a ReDoS attack tool.
+
+Rules:
+1. Change only the vulnerable part(s). Copy every other character of the original exactly (anchors, groups, escapes, character classes, flags).
+2. Remove the ambiguity: every string must have only one way to be matched by the repeated parts.
+   - Nested quantifiers: `(x+)+` becomes `(x+)`, `(?:x*)*` becomes `x*`, `(x+)*` becomes `(x*)`, `(x{2,4})+` becomes `(x{2,})`.
+   - A repeated alternation whose branches overlap: merge single-character branches into one character class and drop branches that are already covered, e.g. `(a|\w)+` becomes `(\w)+`, `(?:\s|.)*` becomes `[\s\S]*`, `(?:\d|[a-f]|-)+` becomes `[\da-f-]+`, `(\w+|_)*` becomes `\w*`.
+   - A repeated sequence with an optional separator: `(\w+\s?)+` becomes `\w+(?:\s\w+)*\s?`, `(?:\d+\.?)*` becomes `(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)*\.?)?`, `([a-z]+-?)+` becomes `[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*-?`.
+   - Adjacent quantified parts that can match the same characters: merge them, e.g. `\s*\s*` becomes `\s*`, `\d+\d*` becomes `\d+`, `[a-z]+[a-z0-9]*` becomes `[a-z][a-z0-9]*`, `.*.*` becomes `.*`.
+   - Anchor the start: if the regex does not already start with `^`, put `^` at the very beginning (after any leading inline flag group such as `(?i)`); if it has a top-level `|`, wrap the whole regex as `^(?:...)`. This never changes which whole strings match, and it stops the matcher from retrying at every position.
+3. Never use lookarounds, backreferences, atomic groups or possessive quantifiers. Keep the whole regex on one line.
+
+Examples:
+Original: ^([a-zA-Z0-9]+)*@example\.com$$
+Repaired: ^([a-zA-Z0-9]*)@example\.com$$
+
+Original: ^(?:\w|-|\d)+$$
+Repaired: ^[\w-]+$$
+
+Original: ^(\w+\s?)*$$
+Repaired: ^(?:\w+(?:\s\w+)*\s?)?$$
+
+Original: ^[a-z]+\d*[a-z0-9]*$$
+Repaired: ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$$
+
+Original: \s*#\s*include\s*<(.*)>
+Repaired: ^\s*#\s*include\s*<(.*)>
+
+Now repair this regular expression:
 $pattern
+
+Answer with only the complete repaired regular expression inside a single code block, and nothing else:
+```
+<repaired regex>
+```

diff --git a/scripts/scalpel_to_thinking_steps.py b/scripts/scalpel_to_thinking_steps.py
index 9da0b69..61c852a 100644
--- a/scripts/scalpel_to_thinking_steps.py
+++ b/scripts/scalpel_to_thinking_steps.py
@@ -1,13 +1,1033 @@
-"""Public policy hooks used by the upstream prompt constructor."""
+"""Public policy hooks used by the upstream prompt constructor.
+
+The localization policy renders every first-step RegexScalpel subpattern
+together with a diagnosis and, when a language-preserving rewrite of that
+subpattern is known, a concrete replacement for the model to substitute.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+import warnings
 
 from parse_regex_scalpel import Result as ScalpelResult
 
+_MARKERS = ("▶▷", "◁◀")
+_INF = None
+
+# Characters used to compare single-character matchers.  Xeger samples are
+# printable ASCII; a few non-ASCII probes keep Unicode-aware classes apart.
+_PROBES = [chr(c) for c in range(128)] + list(
+    "\u00a0\u00e9\u00df\u0416\u4e2d\u2028\u0661\uff10\u00b2\u1680"
+)
+_FULL = frozenset(range(len(_PROBES)))
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Minimal regex syntax tree that preserves the original spelling.
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+class Node:
+    def text(self) -> str:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+
+class Atom(Node):
+    """Single-character matcher, anchor, back-reference or opaque token."""
+
+    def __init__(self, t: str, kind: str = "char") -> None:
+        self.t = t
+        self.kind = kind  # char | anchor | other
+
+    def text(self) -> str:
+        return self.t
+
+
+class Seq(Node):
+    def __init__(self, items: list[Node]) -> None:
+        self.items = items
+
+    def text(self) -> str:
+        return "".join(e.text() for e in self.items)
+
+
+class Alt(Node):
+    def __init__(self, branches: list[Seq]) -> None:
+        self.branches = branches
+
+    def text(self) -> str:
+        return "|".join(e.text() for e in self.branches)
+
+
+class Group(Node):
+    def __init__(self, prefix: str, body: Alt, kind: str) -> None:
+        self.prefix = prefix
+        self.body = body
+        self.kind = kind  # cap | noncap | look | atomic | other
+
+    def text(self) -> str:
+        return self.prefix + self.body.text() + ")"
+
+
+class Rep(Node):
+    def __init__(
+        self, node: Node, lo: int, hi: int | None, suffix: str = ""
+    ) -> None:
+        self.node = node
+        self.lo = lo
+        self.hi = hi
+        self.suffix = suffix  # lazy "?" or possessive "+"
+
+    def quant(self) -> str:
+        lo, hi = self.lo, self.hi
+        if hi is _INF:
+            q = {0: "*", 1: "+"}.get(lo, "{%d,}" % lo)
+        elif lo == 0 and hi == 1:
+            q = "?"
+        elif lo == hi:
+            q = "{%d}" % lo
+        else:
+            q = "{%d,%d}" % (lo, hi)
+        return q + self.suffix
+
+    def text(self) -> str:
+        inner = self.node.text()
+        if isinstance(self.node, (Seq, Alt)) or (
+            isinstance(self.node, Rep)
+        ):
+            inner = "(?:" + inner + ")"
+        return inner + self.quant()
+
+
+class ParseError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+class _Parser:
+    def __init__(self, s: str) -> None:
+        self.s = s
+        self.i = 0
+
+    def peek(self, k: int = 0) -> str:
+        j = self.i + k
+        return self.s[j] if j < len(self.s) else ""
+
+    def parse(self) -> Alt:
+        alt = self.alt()
+        if self.i != len(self.s):
+            raise ParseError("trailing text")
+        return alt
+
+    def alt(self) -> Alt:
+        branches = [self.seq()]
+        while self.peek() == "|":
+            self.i += 1
+            branches.append(self.seq())
+        return Alt(branches)
+
+    def seq(self) -> Seq:
+        items: list[Node] = []
+        while self.i < len(self.s) and self.peek() not in "|)":
+            atom = self.atom()
+            items.append(self.quantified(atom))
+        return Seq(items)
+
+    def quantified(self, atom: Node) -> Node:
+        while True:
+            c = self.peek()
+            if c in ("*", "+", "?"):
+                self.i += 1
+                lo, hi = {"*": (0, _INF), "+": (1, _INF), "?": (0, 1)}[c]
+            elif c == "{":
+                m = re.compile(r"\{(\d*)(,?)(\d*)\}").match(self.s, self.i)
+                if not m or (not m.group(1) and not m.group(3)):
+                    return atom
+                if not m.group(1):
+                    raise ParseError("unsupported quantifier")
+                self.i = m.end()
+                lo = int(m.group(1))
+                if m.group(2):
+                    hi = int(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) else _INF
+                else:
+                    hi = lo
+            else:
+                return atom
+            suffix = ""
+            if self.peek() in ("?", "+"):
+                suffix = self.peek()
+                self.i += 1
+            if isinstance(atom, Atom) and atom.kind == "anchor":
+                raise ParseError("quantified anchor")
+            atom = Rep(atom, lo, hi, suffix)
+
+    def atom(self) -> Node:
+        s, i = self.s, self.i
+        c = s[i]
+        if c == "(":
+            return self.group()
+        if c == "[":
+            j = i + 1
+            if j < len(s) and s[j] == "^":
+                j += 1
+            if j < len(s) and s[j] == "]":
+                j += 1
+            while j < len(s) and s[j] != "]":
+                if s[j] == "\\":
+                    j += 1
+                elif s[j] == "[" and s[j + 1 : j + 2] == ":":
+                    k = s.find(":]", j + 2)
+                    if k > 0:
+                        j = k + 1
+                j += 1
+            if j >= len(s):
+                raise ParseError("open class")
+            self.i = j + 1
+            return Atom(s[i : j + 1])
+        if c == "\\":
+            if i + 1 >= len(s):
+                raise ParseError("dangling escape")
+            d = s[i + 1]
+            if d in "bBAZzG":
+                self.i = i + 2
+                return Atom(s[i : i + 2], "anchor")
+            if d.isdigit() and d != "0":
+                m = re.compile(r"\\\d+").match(s, i)
+                assert m
+                self.i = m.end()
+                return Atom(m.group(0), "other")
+            if d == "x":
+                m = re.compile(r"\\x(\{[0-9a-fA-F]+\}|[0-9a-fA-F]{2})").match(
+                    s, i
+                )
+                if m:
+                    self.i = m.end()
+                    return Atom(m.group(0))
+            if d == "u":
+                m = re.compile(r"\\u[0-9a-fA-F]{4}").match(s, i)
+                if m:
+                    self.i = m.end()
+                    return Atom(m.group(0))
+            if d == "0":
+                m = re.compile(r"\\0[0-7]{0,2}").match(s, i)
+                assert m
+                self.i = m.end()
+                return Atom(m.group(0))
+            if d in "pP" and s[i + 2 : i + 3] == "{":
+                k = s.find("}", i)
+                if k > 0:
+                    self.i = k + 1
+                    return Atom(s[i : k + 1])
+            if d == "k" and s[i + 2 : i + 3] in "<'{":
+                raise ParseError("named reference")
+            if d == "c" and i + 2 < len(s):
+                self.i = i + 3
+                return Atom(s[i : i + 3])
+            if d == "Q":
+                raise ParseError("quoted span")
+            self.i = i + 2
+            return Atom(s[i : i + 2])
+        if c in "^$":
+            self.i = i + 1
+            return Atom(c, "anchor")
+        if c in "*+?":
+            raise ParseError("nothing to repeat")
+        self.i = i + 1
+        return Atom(c)
+
+    def group(self) -> Node:
+        s, i = self.s, self.i
+        rest = s[i:]
+        m = re.compile(
+            r"\((\?(?::|=|!|<=|<!|>|P?<[A-Za-z_]\w*>|'[A-Za-z_]\w*'"
+            r"|[a-zA-Z]*-?[a-zA-Z]*:|#)?)?"
+        ).match(rest)
+        prefix = m.group(0) if m else "("
+        if prefix == "(?":
+            m2 = re.compile(r"\(\?[a-zA-Z]*-?[a-zA-Z]*\)").match(rest)
+            if m2:
+                self.i = i + m2.end()
+                return Atom(m2.group(0), "anchor")
+            raise ParseError("unsupported group")
+        if prefix == "(?#":
+            k = s.find(")", i)
+            if k < 0:
+                raise ParseError("open comment")
+            self.i = k + 1
+            return Atom(s[i : k + 1], "anchor")
+        if prefix == "(":
+            kind = "cap"
+        elif prefix == "(?:":
+            kind = "noncap"
+        elif prefix in ("(?=", "(?!", "(?<=", "(?<!"):
+            kind = "look"
+        elif prefix == "(?>":
+            kind = "atomic"
+        elif prefix.endswith(">") or prefix.endswith("'"):
+            kind = "cap"
+        else:
+            kind = "other"
+        self.i = i + len(prefix)
+        body = self.alt()
+        if self.peek() != ")":
+            raise ParseError("open group")
+        self.i += 1
+        return Group(prefix, body, kind)
+
+
+def parse(s: str) -> Alt:
+    return _Parser(s).parse()
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Character sets of single-character matchers.
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+_CS_CACHE: dict[str, frozenset[int] | None] = {}
+
+
+def _atom_set(t: str) -> frozenset[int] | None:
+    if t in _CS_CACHE:
+        return _CS_CACHE[t]
+    result: frozenset[int] | None
+    try:
+        with warnings.catch_warnings():
+            warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
+            compiled = re.compile(t)
+        result = frozenset(
+            k for k, ch in enumerate(_PROBES) if compiled.fullmatch(ch)
+        )
+    except (re.error, OverflowError, ValueError):
+        result = None
+    _CS_CACHE[t] = result
+    return result
+
+
+def unwrap(node: Node) -> Node:
+    """Strip non-capturing single-item groups."""
+    while (
+        isinstance(node, Group)
+        and node.kind == "noncap"
+        and len(node.body.branches) == 1
+        and len(node.body.branches[0].items) == 1
+    ):
+        node = node.body.branches[0].items[0]
+    if isinstance(node, Seq) and len(node.items) == 1:
+        return unwrap(node.items[0])
+    if isinstance(node, Alt) and len(node.branches) == 1:
+        return unwrap(node.branches[0])
+    return node
+
+
+def charset(node: Node) -> frozenset[int] | None:
+    """Character set when the node matches exactly one character."""
+    node = unwrap(node)
+    if isinstance(node, Atom):
+        if node.kind != "char":
+            return None
+        return _atom_set(node.t)
+    if isinstance(node, Group) and node.kind in ("cap", "noncap"):
+        return charset(node.body)
+    if isinstance(node, Alt):
+        total: frozenset[int] = frozenset()
+        for branch in node.branches:
+            part = charset(branch)
+            if part is None:
+                return None
+            total |= part
+        return total
+    return None
+
+
+def _class_part(node: Node) -> str | None:
+    """Spelling of a single-character matcher inside a bracket class."""
+    node = unwrap(node)
+    if isinstance(node, Group) and node.kind in ("cap", "noncap"):
+        parts = [_class_part(b) for b in node.body.branches]
+        if any(p is None for p in parts):
+            return None
+        return "".join(parts)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    if isinstance(node, Alt):
+        parts = [_class_part(b) for b in node.branches]
+        if any(p is None for p in parts):
+            return None
+        return "".join(parts)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    if not isinstance(node, Atom) or node.kind != "char":
+        return None
+    t = node.t
+    if t.startswith("[^") or t == ".":
+        return None
+    if t.startswith("["):
+        return t[1:-1]
+    if t.startswith("\\"):
+        if t[1:2] in "DWSdws" or len(t) > 2:
+            return t
+        ch = t[1]
+        return "\\" + ch if ch in "\\]^-[" else ch
+    return "\\" + t if t in "\\]^-[" else t
+
+
+def _esc_class_char(ch: str) -> str:
+    named = {"\n": "\\n", "\r": "\\r", "\t": "\\t", "\f": "\\f", "\v": "\\v"}
+    if ch in named:
+        return named[ch]
+    if ch in "\\]^-[":
+        return "\\" + ch
+    if ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127:
+        return "\\x%02x" % ord(ch)
+    return ch
+
+
+def union_text(nodes: list[Node]) -> str | None:
+    """One bracket class (or single matcher) equal to the union of nodes."""
+    sets = [charset(n) for n in nodes]
+    if any(s is None for s in sets):
+        return None
+    total: frozenset[int] = frozenset().union(*sets)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    for n, s in zip(nodes, sets):
+        if s == total:
+            text = unwrap(n).text()
+            if isinstance(unwrap(n), Atom):
+                return text
+    if total == _FULL:
+        return "[\\s\\S]"
+    parts = []
+    for n, s in zip(nodes, sets):
+        if any(s <= t and s != t for t in sets):  # type: ignore[operator]
+            continue
+        part = _class_part(n)
+        if part is None:
+            missing = _FULL - total
+            if all(ord(_PROBES[k]) < 128 for k in missing):
+                return "[^" + "".join(
+                    _esc_class_char(_PROBES[k]) for k in sorted(missing)
+                ) + "]"
+            return None
+        if part not in parts:
+            parts.append(part)
+    text = "[" + "".join(parts) + "]"
+    if _atom_set(text) != total:
+        return None
+    return text
+
+
+_NAMED = ["\\S", "\\D", "\\W", "\\s", "\\d", "\\w", "[^\\n]", "[\\s\\S]"]
+
+
+def set_text(target: frozenset[int]) -> str | None:
+    """Spell a probe set as one character class, when that is unambiguous."""
+    for named in _NAMED:
+        if _atom_set(named) == target:
+            return named
+    if len(target) == 1:
+        (k,) = target
+        ch = _PROBES[k]
+        text = re.escape(ch) if ch.isprintable() else _esc_class_char(ch)
+        if ord(ch) < 128 and _atom_set(text) == target:
+            return text
+    ascii_only = all(ord(_PROBES[k]) < 128 for k in target)
+    if ascii_only and 0 < len(target) <= 64:
+        text = "[" + _ranges(sorted(target)) + "]"
+        if _atom_set(text) == target:
+            return text
+    missing = _FULL - target
+    if all(ord(_PROBES[k]) < 128 for k in missing) and 0 < len(missing) <= 64:
+        text = "[^" + _ranges(sorted(missing)) + "]"
+        if _atom_set(text) == target:
+            return text
+    return None
+
+
+def _ranges(codes: list[int]) -> str:
+    """Spell sorted ASCII codes, compressing alphanumeric runs into ranges."""
+    out: list[str] = []
+    k = 0
+    while k < len(codes):
+        j = k
+        while (
+            j + 1 < len(codes)
+            and codes[j + 1] == codes[j] + 1
+            and chr(codes[j + 1]).isalnum() == chr(codes[k]).isalnum()
+            and chr(codes[k]).isalnum()
+        ):
+            j += 1
+        if j - k >= 2:
+            out.append(chr(codes[k]) + "-" + chr(codes[j]))
+        else:
+            out.extend(_esc_class_char(chr(c)) for c in codes[k : j + 1])
+        k = j + 1
+    return "".join(out)
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Language-preserving rewrites that remove ambiguity.
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _plain(node: Node) -> Node:
+    """A single-character matcher without capturing-group wrappers."""
+    while isinstance(node, Group) and node.kind == "cap":
+        branches = node.body.branches
+        if len(branches) == 1 and len(branches[0].items) == 1:
+            node = unwrap(branches[0].items[0])
+        else:
+            return Group("(?:", node.body, "noncap")
+    return node
+
+
+def _single(node: Node) -> tuple[Node, int, int | None] | None:
+    """View node as C{lo,hi} where C matches exactly one character."""
+    node = unwrap(node)
+    if isinstance(node, Rep):
+        inner = unwrap(node.node)
+        if charset(inner) is not None:
+            return _plain(inner), node.lo, node.hi
+        return None
+    if charset(node) is not None:
+        return _plain(node), 1, 1
+    return None
+
+
+def _rep(node: Node, lo: int, hi: int | None) -> Node:
+    if lo == 1 and hi == 1:
+        return node
+    if isinstance(node, Rep):
+        node = Group("(?:", Alt([Seq([node])]), "noncap")
+    return Rep(node, lo, hi)
+
+
+def _wrap(group: Node, items: list[Node]) -> Node:
+    """Keep a capturing group (and its number) around a rewritten body."""
+    if isinstance(group, Group) and group.kind == "cap":
+        return Group(group.prefix, Alt([Seq(items)]), "cap")
+    if len(items) == 1:
+        return items[0]
+    return Seq(items)
+
+
+def _group_parts(node: Node) -> tuple[Node, list[Seq]] | None:
+    """The outermost group and its branches, looking through noncap wraps."""
+    g = node
+    while (
+        isinstance(g, Group)
+        and g.kind == "noncap"
+        and len(g.body.branches) == 1
+        and len(g.body.branches[0].items) == 1
+        and isinstance(g.body.branches[0].items[0], Group)
+    ):
+        g = g.body.branches[0].items[0]
+    if isinstance(g, Group) and g.kind in ("cap", "noncap"):
+        return g, g.body.branches
+    return None
+
+
+def _cls(node: Node) -> Node:
+    t = node.text()
+    if isinstance(node, Atom):
+        return node
+    return Atom(t)
+
+
+
+def _atoms(node: Node, out: list[str]) -> None:
+    if isinstance(node, Atom):
+        if node.kind == "char":
+            out.append(node.t)
+    elif isinstance(node, (Seq,)):
+        for e in node.items:
+            _atoms(e, out)
+    elif isinstance(node, Alt):
+        for e in node.branches:
+            _atoms(e, out)
+    elif isinstance(node, Group):
+        _atoms(node.body, out)
+    elif isinstance(node, Rep):
+        _atoms(node.node, out)
+
+
+def _closed_under_concat(body: Node) -> bool:
+    """Check (by bounded enumeration) that L(body) L(body) is in L(body)."""
+    atoms: list[str] = []
+    _atoms(body, atoms)
+    sets = [_atom_set(a) for a in atoms]
+    if not atoms or any(x is None for x in sets) or len(atoms) > 12:
+        return False
+    cells: dict[tuple[bool, ...], int] = {}
+    for k in range(len(_PROBES)):
+        sig = tuple(k in x for x in sets)  # type: ignore[operator]
+        if sig not in cells or (not _PROBES[cells[sig]].isprintable() and _PROBES[k].isprintable()):
+            cells[sig] = k
+    alphabet = [_PROBES[k] for k in cells.values()]
+    if len(alphabet) > 7:
+        return False
+    try:
+        with warnings.catch_warnings():
+            warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
+            compiled = re.compile(body.text())
+    except re.error:
+        return False
+    members: list[str] = []
+    frontier = [""]
+    for _ in range(5):
+        frontier = [w + c for w in frontier for c in alphabet]
+        members.extend(w for w in frontier if compiled.fullmatch(w))
+    if not members:
+        return False
+    members.sort(key=len)
+    checks = 0
+    for u in members:
+        for v in members:
+            if len(u) + len(v) > 7:
+                break
+            checks += 1
+            if checks > 4000:
+                return True
+            if not compiled.fullmatch(u + v):
+                return False
+    return True
+
+
+class Rewriter:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.notes: list[str] = []
+        self.exact = True
+
+    # Each rule returns a replacement node or None.
+    def rep(self, r: Rep) -> Node | None:
+        out = self._rep(r)
+        if out is None:
+            out = self.closure(r)
+        return out
+
+    def closure(self, r: Rep) -> Node | None:
+        """(R)+ -> (R) and (R)* -> (R)? when R is closed under concatenation."""
+        if r.hi is not _INF or r.lo > 1:
+            return None
+        gp = _group_parts(r.node)
+        if gp is None:
+            return None
+        group, branches = gp
+        if not any(isinstance(unwrap(e), Rep) for b in branches for e in b.items):
+            return None
+        if not _closed_under_concat(Group("(?:", Alt(branches), "noncap")):
+            return None
+        self.notes.append("repetition of a group that already covers its own repetitions")
+        body = group if isinstance(group, Group) and group.kind == "cap" else Group("(?:", Alt(branches), "noncap")
+        if len(branches) == 1 and not (isinstance(group, Group) and group.kind == "cap"):
+            inner: Node = Seq(branches[0].items)
+            return Rep(Group("(?:", Alt([Seq([inner])]), "noncap"), 0, 1) if r.lo == 0 else inner
+        return Rep(body, 0, 1) if r.lo == 0 else body
+
+    def _rep(self, r: Rep) -> Node | None:
+        if r.hi is not _INF and r.hi <= 1:
+            return None
+        gp = _group_parts(r.node)
+        if gp is None:
+            return None
+        group, branches = gp
+        if len(branches) == 1:
+            items = [unwrap(e) for e in branches[0].items]
+            items = [e for e in items if not (isinstance(e, Atom) and e.kind == "anchor" and e.t.startswith("(?#"))]
+            if len(items) == 1 and isinstance(items[0], Rep):
+                return self.nested(r, group, items[0])
+            if len(items) in (2, 3):
+                return self.loop_seq(r, group, items)
+            return None
+        return self.alternation(r, group, branches)
+
+    def nested(self, r: Rep, group: Node, inner: Rep) -> Node | None:
+        a, b = inner.lo, inner.hi
+        lo, hi = r.lo, r.hi
+        if b is not _INF and a == b:
+            return None
+        if b is _INF:
+            new_lo = lo * a
+            new_hi: int | None = _INF
+        else:
+            assert b is not None
+            if hi is _INF:
+                totals = {0} if lo == 0 else set()
+                for k in range(max(lo, 1), 60):
+                    totals.update(range(k * a, k * b + 1))
+                new_lo = lo * a
+                gap = [n for n in range(new_lo, 40) if n not in totals]
+                if gap:
+                    self.exact = False
+                new_hi = _INF
+            else:
+                new_lo, new_hi = lo * a, hi * b
+                totals = set()
+                for k in range(lo, hi + 1):
+                    totals.update(range(k * a, k * b + 1))
+                if any(n not in totals for n in range(new_lo, new_hi + 1)):
+                    self.exact = False
+        self.notes.append("nested quantifier")
+        core = inner.node
+        sub = self.fix(_rep(core, new_lo, new_hi))
+        return _wrap(group, [sub])
+
+    def alternation(self, r: Rep, group: Node, branches: list[Seq]) -> Node | None:
+        singles: list[Node] = []
+        nullable = False
+        multi: list[Seq] = []
+        for br in branches:
+            items = [unwrap(e) for e in br.items]
+            if not items:
+                nullable = True
+                continue
+            if len(items) == 1:
+                sv = _single(items[0])
+                if sv is not None and (sv[2] is _INF or sv[1] == sv[2] == 1):
+                    if sv[1] == 0:
+                        nullable = True
+                    singles.append(sv[0])
+                    continue
+            multi.append(br)
+        if not singles:
+            return None
+        if r.hi is not _INF and any(
+            _single(unwrap(br.items[0]))[1:] != (1, 1)  # type: ignore[index]
+            for br in branches
+            if len(br.items) == 1 and _single(unwrap(br.items[0]))
+        ):
+            return None
+        total = charset(Alt([Seq([s]) for s in singles]))
+        if total is None:
+            return None
+        kept: list[Seq] = []
+        for br in multi:
+            covered = True
+            for e in br.items:
+                sv = _single(e)
+                cs = charset(sv[0]) if sv else None
+                if cs is None or not cs <= total:
+                    covered = False
+                    break
+            if not covered:
+                kept.append(br)
+        if r.hi is not _INF and len(kept) != len(multi):
+            return None
+        if len(singles) < 2 and len(kept) == len(multi) and not any(
+            isinstance(unwrap(br.items[0]), Rep)
+            for br in branches
+            if len(br.items) == 1
+        ):
+            return None
+        u = union_text(singles)
+        if u is None:
+            return None
+        lo = 0 if nullable else r.lo
+        self.notes.append("overlapping alternatives inside a repetition")
+        if kept:
+            new_branches = [Seq([Atom(u)])] + kept
+            body = Group("(?:", Alt(new_branches), "noncap")
+            if isinstance(group, Group) and group.kind == "cap":
+                body = Group(group.prefix, Alt(new_branches), "cap")
+            self.exact = self.exact and not nullable
+            return Rep(body, lo, r.hi)
+        return _wrap(group, [_rep(Atom(u), lo, r.hi)])
+
+    def loop_seq(self, r: Rep, group: Node, items: list[Node]) -> Node | None:
+        views = [_single(e) for e in items]
+        if any(v is None for v in views):
+            return None
+        if r.hi is not _INF or r.lo > 1:
+            return None
+        (x, xa, xb), (y, ya, yb) = views[0], views[1]  # type: ignore[misc]
+        X, Y = charset(x), charset(y)
+        assert X is not None and Y is not None
+        star = r.lo == 0
+        res: list[Node] | None = None
+        if len(items) == 3:
+            z, za, zb = views[2]  # type: ignore[misc]
+            Z = charset(z)
+            if (
+                X == Z
+                and X.isdisjoint(Y)
+                and xa == 0
+                and za == 0
+                and xb is _INF
+                and zb is _INF
+                and ya >= 1
+            ):
+                # (X* Y X*)+  ->  X*Y(?:X*Y)*X*   (X* Y+ X*)+ -> X*Y+(?:X+Y+)*X*
+                yy = _rep(y, ya, yb)
+                sep = _rep(x, 1 if yb is _INF else 0, _INF)
+                res = [
+                    _rep(x, 0, _INF),
+                    yy,
+                    Rep(Group("(?:", Alt([Seq([sep, yy])]), "noncap"), 0, _INF),
+                    _rep(x, 0, _INF),
+                ]
+                if yb is not _INF and yb != ya:
+                    res = None
+            if res is None:
+                return None
+        else:
+            disjoint = X.isdisjoint(Y)
+            if disjoint and xb is _INF and xa == 1 and ya == 0 and yb in (1, _INF):
+                # (X+Y?)+ -> X+(?:YX+)*Y?   (X+Y*)+ -> X+(?:Y+X+)*Y*
+                yy = _rep(y, 1, yb)
+                res = [
+                    _rep(x, 1, _INF),
+                    Rep(Group("(?:", Alt([Seq([yy, _rep(x, 1, _INF)])]), "noncap"), 0, _INF),
+                    _rep(y, 0, yb),
+                ]
+            elif disjoint and xa == 0 and xb in (1, _INF) and ya == 1 and yb is _INF:
+                # (X?Y+)+ -> X?Y+(?:XY+)*   (X*Y+)+ -> X*Y+(?:X+Y+)*
+                res = [
+                    _rep(x, 0, xb),
+                    _rep(y, 1, _INF),
+                    Rep(Group("(?:", Alt([Seq([_rep(x, 1, xb), _rep(y, 1, _INF)])]), "noncap"), 0, _INF),
+                ]
+            elif (
+                xa == 0
+                and ya == 0
+                and (xb is _INF or yb is _INF)
+            ):
+                # (X*Y?)+ and friends -> [XY]*
+                u = union_text([x, y])
+                if u is None:
+                    return None
+                self.notes.append("repetition of an optional sequence")
+                return _wrap(group, [_rep(Atom(u), 0, _INF)])
+            elif Y <= X and xb is _INF and xa <= 1 and ya == 0:
+                # (X+Y?)+ -> X+ when Y is contained in X
+                res = [_rep(x, xa, _INF)]
+                star = star or xa == 0
+            elif Y <= X and xb is _INF and xa == 0 and ya == 1 and yb == 1:
+                res = [_rep(x, 0, _INF), y]  # (X*Y)+ -> X*Y
+            elif Y <= X and xb is _INF and xa == 1 and ya == 1 and yb is _INF:
+                res = [_rep(x, 1, _INF), y]  # (X+Y+)+ -> X+Y
+            elif Y <= X and xb is _INF and xa >= 1 and ya == 1 and yb == 1:
+                res = [_rep(x, xa, _INF), y]  # (X{a,}Y)+ -> X{a,}Y
+            elif X <= Y and not Y <= X and xb is _INF and xa == 1 and ya == 1 and yb == 1:
+                # (X+Y)+ -> (?:X+N)+(?:XX+)?|XX+  with N = Y - X
+                nd = set_text(Y - X)
+                if nd is None:
+                    return None
+                n_atom = Atom(nd)
+                body = Alt([
+                    Seq([
+                        Rep(Group("(?:", Alt([Seq([_rep(x, 1, _INF), n_atom])]), "noncap"), 1, _INF),
+                        Rep(Group("(?:", Alt([Seq([x, _rep(x, 1, _INF)])]), "noncap"), 0, 1),
+                    ]),
+                    Seq([x, _rep(x, 1, _INF)]),
+                ])
+                res = [Group("(?:", body, "noncap")]
+            elif X <= Y and xa == 1 and xb in (1, _INF) and ya == 0 and yb is _INF:
+                res = [x, _rep(y, 0, _INF)]  # (X+Y*)+ and (XY*)+ -> XY*
+            elif X <= Y and xa == 0 and xb == 1 and ya == 1 and yb is _INF:
+                res = [_rep(y, 1, _INF)]  # (X?Y+)+ -> Y+
+            else:
+                return None
+        self.notes.append("repetition of a sequence that can be split in several ways")
+        if star:
+            inner = Group("(?:", Alt([Seq(res)]), "noncap")
+            if isinstance(group, Group) and group.kind == "cap":
+                inner = Group(group.prefix, Alt([Seq(res)]), "cap")
+                return Rep(inner, 0, 1)
+            return Rep(inner, 0, 1)
+        return _wrap(group, res)
+
+    def seq(self, items: list[Node]) -> list[Node]:
+        """Merge adjacent repetitions of overlapping characters."""
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            for k in range(len(items) - 1):
+                a, b = _single(items[k]), _single(items[k + 1])
+                if a is None or b is None:
+                    continue
+                if not (
+                    isinstance(unwrap(items[k]), Rep)
+                    or isinstance(unwrap(items[k + 1]), Rep)
+                ):
+                    continue
+                (x, xa, xb), (y, ya, yb) = a, b
+                if xb is not _INF and yb is not _INF:
+                    continue
+                X, Y = charset(x), charset(y)
+                assert X is not None and Y is not None
+                new: list[Node] | None = None
+                if X <= Y and yb is _INF and xb != xa:
+                    # X{a,b}Y{c,} == X{a}Y{c,} when X is inside Y
+                    new = ([_rep(x, xa, xa)] if xa else []) + [_rep(y, ya, _INF)]
+                elif Y <= X and xb is _INF and yb != ya:
+                    new = [_rep(x, xa, _INF)] + ([_rep(y, ya, ya)] if ya else [])
